name: Waveshare 4.2" B/W e-paper
description: 4.2 inch monochrome ePaper module, 400x300, driven by an ESP32 client. Frames are dithered server-side to 1-bpp and pushed over MQTT as a packed buffer.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Pair with the tesserae-device-esp32-bw firmware.
